Either guard failure enters the existing deferred-cleanup error branch with status preserved; no ownership pointer/count clearing or physical free is introduced. The unchanged caller stops before boot on nonzero status.
original_changes: Limited-table linear and DFS scans examine actual nonzero functions even when function0 is outside the retained ancestry; missing tuples remain cheap software misses
